topics.name: Decision Tree
topics.description: A supervised learning model that splits data by selecting questions that best separate classes, illustrated with worked examples and applications.

topics.name: Random Forest
topics.description: An ensemble of many decision trees trained on random data subsets, using majority voting; covered with mechanics, calculations, and trade‑offs.

topics.name: K-Means Clustering
topics.description: An unsupervised learning algorithm that groups similar data points by iteratively moving toward centroids; explained with examples and real‑world uses.

topics.name: Supervised vs Unsupervised Learning
topics.description: The overarching framework distinguishing models that require labeled data (Decision Tree, Random Forest) from those that do not (K-Means).

topics.name: Hands‑On Walkthrough (Model Mechanics, Worked Calculations, Applications, Trade‑offs)
topics.description: Practical section that walks through the mathematics, implementation steps, real‑world applications, and pros/cons of the three models.
